discussion.body: FEAT-011 Dev panel and flags -- impl status: built. DEV_MODE on through this phase. Panel: space (id, nest, parent, scaleToParent, origin, to-root display), camera, precision (ulp, max |coord|, spawn band), last ops, flags with one-line descriptions, editable. How to verify: open the right-edge strip, toggle SPACE_CHECKERBOARD, confirm the ground changes.
